name: Marley Spoon Group SE
summary: Marley Spoon Group SE, through its subsidiary, Marley Spoon SE, operates as a direct-to-consumer meal-kit company. The company provides original recipes with ingredients to prepare and cook, and ready-to-heat meals. It operates in Australia, the United States, and Europe under the Marley Spoon, Dinnerly, Chefgood, and bistroMD brands. Marley Spoon Group SE was founded in 2014 and is based in Luxembourg, Luxembourg.
